scope.target: HARNESS-L2-015 TDD development flow: L3/L10 F03, F04, B01
included: L3 requirements and L10 verification requirements for HARNESS-L3/L10-015-F03, F04, B01
L4 tdd-development-flow.json allowed pointers: /scope, /purpose, /architecture, /contracts/0, /contracts/3, /contracts/4 and the allowed child fields
Source prose in L3/L10 Markdown for those same three IDs
excluded: TDD L5, L8, and L9 files
L4 algorithm/procedural interpretation, including /architecture/data_flow as derivation evidence
L4 negative_classifications and existing structured classification/expected rows
Existing assignment comparison and Issue posting
scope.derivation_status: independent source-only derivation; no execution evidence

hash_method: For JSON pointer values, SHA-256 is over UTF-8 compact JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'). Document hashes are SHA-256 over raw file bytes.

sources.derivation_limit: Only role/boundary prose was considered. The architecture data_flow sequence and algorithm-like detail were excluded from derivation.

independent_negative_cases.negative_condition: Frozen oracle is weakened or replaced to make the implementation pass; or the Green observation does not satisfy the same frozen oracle.
independent_negative_cases.expected_observation: Do not recognize Green closure. Preserve oracle identity/content mismatch and route the semantic change upstream; do not count a pass against a changed expectation.

independent_negative_cases.negative_condition: The implementation body is changed before the intended pre-body Red is observed, or the required causal order is inverted.
independent_negative_cases.expected_observation: Keep the pre-body Red obligation unsatisfied; later evidence cannot establish the missing earlier observation. Do not close the F03 sequence.
basis: L3 F03 obligation: after pre-body Red

independent_negative_cases.negative_condition: A local refactor changes public contract, requirement meaning, architecture meaning, or state meaning.
independent_negative_cases.expected_observation: Do not accept it as a meaning-preserving local refactor; preserve the change as an upstream/backflow obligation to the relevant owner/layer.

independent_negative_cases.negative_condition: Extra behavior outside the minimal body scope is added, or an incorrect observed Green is treated as satisfying the oracle.
independent_negative_cases.expected_observation: Preserve the out-of-scope behavior or wrong observation as an unresolved failure; successful unrelated behavior cannot cancel it.
independent_negative_cases.qualification: The example receiver/debit values in L4 are fixture-specific and are not generalized into a system-wide numeric rule.

independent_negative_cases.negative_condition: Atomic CI success is presented as product quality, system verification, user acceptance, or release completion.
independent_negative_cases.expected_observation: Keep F03/atomic-CI evidence separate from higher verification and acceptance; do not produce those higher states from this CI result.

independent_negative_cases.negative_condition: Design/test-to-code trace is one-way or points to a different target revision.
independent_negative_cases.expected_observation: Report the missing reverse edge or revision mismatch; do not treat trace as bidirectional/current or close the obligation.

independent_negative_cases.negative_condition: ④ development alone, or its atomic CI Green, is used to claim Integrated, quality completion, Accepted, or Release.
independent_negative_cases.expected_observation: Cap the standalone output at Provisional and retain Integrated/verification/acceptance/release as unestablished pending their own contracts and owners.

independent_negative_cases.negative_condition: Use without OS-operated CI is rejected categorically even though the same contract is passed to user CI; or cost/time improvement is claimed as success while required quality is unmet.
independent_negative_cases.expected_observation: Preserve standalone user-CI use as an allowed form, but keep quality unmet and improvement success ungenerated when required quality is not met.

independent_negative_cases.negative_condition: An omitted inspection is erased, or a measurement improvement is converted into acceptance/effect success.
independent_negative_cases.expected_observation: Retain the unrecovered inspection and separate measurement/cost/time improvement from quality and user acceptance; do not generate acceptance from the metric.

leaf_reuse.observation: L4 original_l3 leaf is byte-semantically identical under the declared canonical JSON hash to the corresponding L3 F03 record.
L4 original_l3 leaf is byte-semantically identical under the declared canonical JSON hash to the corresponding L3 F04 record.
L4 original_l3 leaf is byte-semantically identical under the declared canonical JSON hash to the corresponding L3 B01 record.
The same input-contract prose is reused across the three selected L4 contract leaves; whether this reuse is semantically intended or merely a shared fixture note is uncertain.
The normative-contract-only/no-execution effect leaf is shared across the three selected contracts.

unresolved.sequence_equality: The sources establish causal/order constraints (notably pre-body Red before body change, followed by Green/refactor/atomic CI), but do not specify a canonical sequence encoding, identity, or exact equality comparator. Derivation checks order/causality only; exact sequence equality remains undecided.
unresolved.failure_code: L4 failure_conditions contain local code labels, but L3/L10 prose does not establish a normative failure-code vocabulary, mapping, or precedence. No code is elevated to a canonical output code; code selection remains undecided.
unresolved.oracle_unit_vs_u_id_rows: The L3/L10 contracts are oracle-contract units (F03, F04, B01); a U-ID row would be a finer test/fixture instance. One contract can motivate multiple negative conditions, and one condition could need multiple row fixtures. No one-to-one mapping or U-ID identity is inferred here.
unresolved.architecture_algorithm_boundary: The /architecture pointer includes an ordered data_flow and detailed connections. These were not used to derive negative cases because the request excludes L4 algorithmic content; only non-algorithmic role/boundary prose was considered.
unresolved.fixture_authority: L4 input/output contract prose labels examples synthetic/minimal and says real operation/authority/codec need separate binding. No runtime result, authority state, or formal codec is inferred from these fixtures.

verification.artifact_sha256: reported externally; self-hash is intentionally not embedded
